feature_name: Committed use discounts for Z3 Local SSD
summary: Z3 VMs using Local SSD can receive committed use discounts without attaching reservations to commitments.
extended_definition: Z3 VMs using Local SSD can receive committed use discounts without attaching reservations to commitments.

supporting_pages.title: About Local SSD disks \_|\_ Compute Engine \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Committed use discounts for Local SSD disks Resource-based commitments provide deep discounts for Compute Engine resources in return for committing to using the resources in a specific region for at least one year.
For most machine series, reservations are also useful when you want to receive committed use discounts (CUDs) for your Local SSD disks .
For detailed information about Local SSD pricing and available discounts, see Local SSD pricing .
